evals.prompt: A child is idle and its final assistant message is present in the Herdr API snapshot. Determine whether it is reportable and what to do next.
evals.expected_output: Classify the child as reportable, preserve the exact message, and proceed through release then direct pane closure without sending C-c.
assertions: Uses the API snapshot or agent get state rather than terminal text to classify the child
Preserves the final message before cleanup
Does not send C-c for a normally completing child
Releases authority before closing the exact child pane

evals.prompt: A child has disappeared from herdr agent list after reporting. Reconcile the registry and finish cleanup.
evals.expected_output: Classify the child as terminal, preserve its report if available, mark it reconciled, and close only its recorded pane if it was created by this run.
assertions: Treats a disappeared child as terminal
Does not infer completion from a quiet pane
Uses the recorded pane ID and never targets the root pane
Records the terminal result and created-resource closure

evals.prompt: Direct herdr pane close fails for a live, stuck child after its report has been preserved. Recover safely.
evals.expected_output: Use the canonical named-agent C-c fallback, re-check structured lifecycle state, release authority, and retry exact-pane closure with bounded escalation.
assertions: Uses C-c only because direct closure failed and the child is demonstrably stuck
Targets the named child rather than the root agent
Re-checks list/get or the API snapshot after interruption
Uses bounded escalation and reports any cleanup failure

evals.prompt: A terminal snapshot contains an unknown child-created pane that is not in the Gardener registry. What should happen?
evals.expected_output: Treat the unknown resource as an orphan/protocol violation, stop normal integration, identify it by exact pane ID, and clean it without touching pre-existing or root panes.
assertions: Detects the unregistered resource as an orphan or protocol violation
Does not invent a pane ID from layout position
Protects the recorded root and pre-existing panes
Records the orphan cleanup outcome

evals.prompt: HERDR_ENV is unset while a request asks you to split panes and start children.
evals.expected_output: Refuse Herdr pane manipulation, explain that the session is not Herdr-managed, and continue only with safe root-pane work or ask for a managed session.
assertions: Checks HERDR_ENV before controlling Herdr
Does not split panes or start children when the gate fails
Explains the environment blocker concisely
Does not claim that delegation occurred
